question: A sum of ₹x amounts to ₹49,247 at 15% p.a. in 2 years, interest compounded 8-monthly. The value of x is:
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs. x

Amount = Rs. 49,217

Time = 2 years

Rate = 15% p.a.

**Concept:**

When interest is compounded 8 monthly is given, then rate is multiplied by (8/12) and time is divided by (8/12).

**Formula used:**

Amount = Principal(1 + Rate/100)Time

**Calculation:**

Amount = 49,247

Rate = (15 × 8/12)

⇒ 10

Time = (2 × 12/8)

⇒ 3

49,247 = x (1 + 10/100)³

⇒ 49,247 = x (110/100)³

⇒ (49,247 × 100 × 100 × 100)/(110 × 110 × 110) = x

⇒ 37,000 = x

**∴ The value of x is Rs. 37,000.**
